♟️ Privacy Chess

A fully-featured chess game that runs entirely in your browser with zero external dependencies, tracking, or server connection. Every aspect of your game stays on your device.

No JavaScript frameworks, no external CDNs, no analytics. Save and load games in standard PGN format — all files stay local.

White to move
Tap a piece to select, then tap destination.
All games stay on your device only.
